general_information.name: SORRY—DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY ID? I ALWAYS GET THIS SORT OF THING MIXED UP. IT’S JAMAL… WHITFIELD, I THINK, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE MIDDLE BIT TOO OR JUST THE FULL THING.
general_information.address: Um… sorry, I’m getting a bit tangled. Do you mean like the street and the city, or the whole mailing address? I can never remember which part goes where.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s kind of hard to explain properly. Over the last while—maybe around eight months or so—I’ve had this growing feeling that the neighbours are watching me and talking about me, and then sometimes I hear my name being called when nobody’s there, which sounds stupid when I say it out loud. I keep wondering if it’s real or if I’m just getting myself worked up, and I ended up dropping out of my college course because I couldn’t focus on it. I just want to figure out what’s going on and get back to the course, really.
current_concerns.goals: I want to work out what is happening to me… and get back to my course.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a sociable child… that’s really the main thing I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished high school, then I started a college programme when I was 19, and I withdrew when I was 21. It got too hard to keep up, I guess.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I… don’t really have anything like that to report. I live with my mother, and I used to keep in touch with two school friends, but that’s kind of dropped off.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to finish my course and move into my own place.
